name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a Toronto-based silver-gold development company advancing the Diablillos project, a 100%-owned, fully permitted, DFS-complete primary silver-gold deposit in Salta Province, Argentina. The project hosts a Measured and Indicated Resource of 103.9 Mt grading 59 g/t silver and 0.51 g/t gold. The company is in the advanced development stage, targeting a Final Investment Decision in Q2 2027 and first production by year-end 2029.
